<thought>All measured resistances are consistent with a single series chain from node A to node B. By ordering the intermediate nodes according to their resistance from A (0 → 5 → 15 → 30 → 50 → 60 → 75 → 95 → 105 → 120 → 140 Ω) the resistor values are the differences between successive values. This yields ten resistors whose series sum is 140 Ω, matching every pairwise measurement. The connections follow the node order A → N_a1 → N_a2 → N_a3 → X1 → N_b1 → N_b2 → X2 → N_c1 → N_c2 → B.</thought>
